text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working freelancer with 6 years of experience in data and machine learning, and I’d be glad to help with your STATA exercise.

While my main background is in Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning, I’m comfortable working on analytical tasks and interpreting results clearly. I can support your economics/internal economics exercise and provide a concise interpretation alongside the solution.

One relevant project was Coffee review themes for Cobalt Coffee Roasters, where I built a Streamlit app in Python with BERTopic, Hugging Face Transformers, and pandas to group 38k marketplace reviews into themes and track sentiment each week. That work produced 12 stable themes and replaced about 2 days a month of manual tagging.

I’d be happy to help you meet the February 28 deadline.
